data.title: Bitcoin Core update: v30 sparks OP_RETURN limit controversy
data.text: Bitcoin Core update v30 was released in October 2025, reigniting debate over how much arbitrary data can be stored on-chain. Version v30 raises the default allowance for OP_RETURN payloads and exposes the limit via the -datacarriersize option. Consequently, larger amounts of arbitrary data — including potential inscriptions on bitcoin blockchain — can be relayed and accepted by nodes. For exchanges, custodians and institutional users, that raises questions about bandwidth, storage and reputational exposure.
